body: IDUNA Client.Auth() used to skip re-fetching as long as the cached token claimed >5min of life left. That couldn't self-heal from a token invalidated some other way mid-run (e.g. across an IDUNA restart), which is exactly the UNAUTHENTICATED error the founder hit live. Removed the cache-reuse early-return; Auth() now always POSTs to /api/v1/auth/agent. New test TestAuth_AlwaysFetchesFreshEvenWithinExpiryWindow confirms 2 calls = 2 real auth requests. Commit 6ef3945.
title: Fix stale-JWT UNAUTHENTICATED errors: always fetch fresh token
